payload.body: WP-02 landed at b1e2864, AT28 green, for verification of cdp.rs, clock.js and record.rs. New finding, in design.md as built: the first CDP advance after a load lands 8 ms past the page's clock, so the harness settles with one 1 ms advance before reading t0; frame 0 is then 11 ms late and every frame from 1 on is within 0.1 ms of t0 + 100i. Against Chrome 153: 160 frames byte-identical at full speed and at a 0.02 s nap per frame; a refused frame and a real SIGINT each left no process and no directory. 324 workspace tests; clippy, rustfmt, critic and doctor clean. Next: video.sh red-first with your two stanza fixes.
